Marta (Rosetta): Hey team — quick sync on the Rosetta private deploy. We're in week2 and blocked on KMS rotation policy + where audit logs should land. Can we confirm target retention and the S3 prefix? cc @Asha @Liam @Priya
Asha (CSE): Hi Marta — we can handle both. Quick Q: do you need customer-managed key (CMK) in your acct, or will Redwood-hosted key with imported key material work for the initial cutover? Also what retention period compliance requires?
Liam (NetEng): From networking side, we need the exact destination CIDR for the SIEM/export endpoint and whether you want PrivateLink or VPC peering for egress. PrivateLink avoids route table changes.
Priya (Security): For KMS rotation: if you require 90-day rotation with audit trail, we need the key policy to include our service principal and a cross-account role. Also request that S3 bucket enforce server-side encryption and object lock if retention > 1 year.
Asha (CSE): Actionable plan I propose:
- Confirm KMS model (CMK vs Redwood)
- Provide S3 bucket ARN + prefix for audit logs
- IAM role ARN for Redwood write access
- Network endpoint CIDR or FQDN for SIEM
If we get these today we can push the config and do a dry-run tomorrow. Heads-up: missing KMS/retention could become a renewal risk for their compliance audit at month-end.
Marta (Rosetta): Compliance needs 7 years retention and EU residency (eu-west-1). We can provide a locked bucket and will require CMK in our account. Also need a copy to our Splunk endpoint via HTTPS. Any cost delta from long-term retention?
Asha (CSE): Got it — CMK in your account is fine. Cost note: longer retention adds storage cost; roughly +5% on current estimate for infrequent access lifecycle if you enable IA after 90 days. I can attach a customized estimate after we have bucket prefix. We'll also enable manifest exports to your bucket via the Console.
DeployBot: deployment-task created: "rosetta-audit-export-220111" — assignee: Asha (CSE). Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/tasks/220111-audit-export
Liam (NetEng): For PrivateLink terraform example (if helpful):
```
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "redwood_audit" {
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.eu-west-1.execute-api"
  vpc_id       = var.vpc_id
  subnet_ids   = var.subnet_ids
  security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.allow_redwood.id]
}
```
This avoids adding routes for every subnet and keeps traffic within AWS backbone.
Priya (Security): Also: require that the CMK policy includes a rotate-key permission and that Redwood's write role has sts:AssumeRole only from your audit bucket service principal. We'll need a short PR with the exact policy. Can you open a ticket with your GRC doc attached?
Marta (Rosetta): Will create the ticket and post the bucket ARN + Splunk FQDN by EOD. Thanks — appreciate the speed. :+1:
Asha (CSE): Great — once we have the ARN I'll run the preflight. If anything blocks the key delegation we'll schedule a 30m bridge tomorrow morning.
Marta (Rosetta): OK scheduled — will sync with our infra team. Thanks everyone! :wave:
